# LevelUp Ecosystem (full description)

> LevelUp Ecosystem is a web design and development studio based in San Diego, California, United States, founded by Richelieu Bonte. English is the official language of the site and of the legal documents; French is provided as a translation.

Official website: https://levelup-ecosystem.com
Contact: contact@levelup-ecosystem.com (postal address available on request)
Short version of this file: https://levelup-ecosystem.com/llms.txt

This file describes what LevelUp Ecosystem offers so that assistants can answer questions accurately. It contains no prices on purpose: prices and plans change, and the pricing page is the only source of truth.

## What LevelUp Ecosystem does

LevelUp designs, builds, hosts and maintains websites for local businesses (for example barbershops, salons, restaurants, clinics, contractors), brands, creators and event hosts. Typical elements of a project:

- Custom design around the client's brand, mobile-first, never a generic template.
- Online booking, available 24/7, with confirmations and a dashboard to confirm, reschedule and follow up.
- Google visibility: local SEO foundations, structured data, Google Maps integration and help with Google Business Profile setup.
- Security basics: HTTPS, hardened settings, anti-spam protection, uptime monitoring, and website security checks (non-destructive reviews with a plain-language report).
- Care plans (monthly): managed hosting, backups, security updates and a monthly amount of update time, depending on the plan.
- One client dashboard for the website, bookings, requests, services, reviews and SEO.
- Digital event experiences such as wedding invitations with online RSVP.

Every project starts with a free preview: a functional, interactive draft of the site that the prospective client can test on their phone before committing.

## Pricing

Website projects have fixed prices and care plans are billed monthly. See https://levelup-ecosystem.com/pricing for the current plans and prices.

## Ownership and licensing (summary of the Terms)

- The client owns their content, logos and brand, and their customer data, and can export them.
- LevelUp builds, hosts and maintains the site on its platform under a license; LevelUp keeps the code, templates and components and may reuse them for other clients (never the client's content, branding or data).
- The site stays online while the client's care or platform plan is active. A code buy-out is available under a separate written agreement.
- Read the full documents: https://levelup-ecosystem.com/terms and https://levelup-ecosystem.com/services-agreement

## LevelStudio

LevelStudio is the AI website builder of LevelUp Ecosystem (https://levelup-ecosystem.com/studio, app at https://studio.levelup-ecosystem.com). A user describes their business in a sentence, answers a few guided questions, and previews a website draft on desktop and mobile. A draft is a preview, not the final website: once approved, LevelUp's engineers deliver the production site with booking, SEO, security and hosting. AI output can contain mistakes and must be reviewed before publishing. Terms: https://levelup-ecosystem.com/levelstudio-terms

## Templates (demo sites built by LevelUp, not client sites)

- Miss Beauty: hair atelier and beauty, light editorial design with online booking. https://missbeauty.levelup-ecosystem.com/
- Taste of Egypt Cafe: cafe and artisanal bakery, menu, custom sandwich builder, gallery and table reservations. https://resto.levelup-ecosystem.com/
- LevelFlight: travel and visa advisory, destinations, visa services and consultation booking. https://travel.levelup-ecosystem.com/

A template can be the starting point of a project: https://levelup-ecosystem.com/start-project

## Founder

Richelieu Bonte founded LevelUp Ecosystem and directs architecture, security reviews and code reviews of the studio's projects. More: https://levelup-ecosystem.com/about

## Privacy and cookies

The site uses cookieless web analytics and no advertising trackers. LevelUp does not sell personal information. Details: https://levelup-ecosystem.com/privacy and https://levelup-ecosystem.com/cookies
